conventions.units: SI. Location coordinates in meters (inferred); MIF = max isometric force in newtons.
conventions.location: MATLAB location matrix, native orientation 3xN: rows = x, y, z coordinates; columns = successive path points from origin to insertion (i.e. transposed relative to 'rows = points'). Units: meters (inferred - no explicit unit comment; magnitudes and skeleton home positions ~0.4 m are consistent with meters). Points whose column index appears in crosspoints are expressed in the next body frame and transformed by the pose-dependent frame stack T (4x4xnframesxnposes, built per section; not extracted).
conventions.crosspoints: Column indices (1-based) into the Location matrix marking where the muscle path crosses into a new reference frame. Source comment: 'Via points are the points where a transformation matrix is needed. Typically wrap point + 1'. A leading 0 means the muscle starts after the first joint and the 0 is skipped (PamData.m computeMuscleLength/computeMomentArm). These are indices, not coordinates - dimensionless.
conventions.axis: Per-crossing-point axis indices; one row per crossing point (length matches CrossPoints), one column per output torque axis of interest. 1/2/3 = x/y/z with the moment-arm cross product rotated into the joint frame; 10/20/30 = same axes WITHOUT frame rotation (source line 73 comment; PamData.m CrossProd: n>9 -> n/10 with NoRotate=1); 0 = no moment arm computed for that crossing. Column-vector form retained as single-element rows.
conventions.T: Pose-dependent transformation-matrix stack (4x4xnframesxnposes), built per joint section; referenced by every call but not extracted.
conventions.helper_file_artifact: PamData.m line 271 (Size function) contains a stray '9hi' token after a statement - committed in git history (23b0e78); a MATLAB parse error if that file is loaded as-is. Left unmodified per task scope.
